summary: ⑤ Metric-aware tradeoff judge DONE. Edited ONLY skills/self-learn-judge/SKILL.md (no daemon/lib/test changes — all signals already on the node, attach_knowledge is free-form). Changes: (1) frontmatter description now says judge metric-first when spec+measurements present, else fall back. (2) Step 3 forks into metric-aware mode (P.metric present + attempts carry node.measurement) vs fallback mode (test pass/fail + rationale, unchanged). (3) New "Metric-aware judging" section: read node.measurement.value vs .baseline.value under metric.direction (improvement); compare measurement.guardrails vs baseline.guardrails under each guardrail's direction (regression = near-veto, mirrors lib/measure.js evalGuardrails by hand); when node.benchmark present compare measured vs benchmark.value weighted by confidence (high/med/low), absent⇒baseline-only, never fabricate. Explicit "judgment not arithmetic"; evaluate-only, no generation. (4) Step 6 verdict payload extended with metric/direction/metric_value/baseline_value/improvement/guardrails_ok/guardrail_notes/vs_benchmark for ⑥ to read. (5) Hold-merge block + step 7 close-out fold metric value/improvement/benchmark gap into the verdict/summary. (6) Two new guardrail bullets (metric mode = evaluate not generate, never fabricate benchmark, guardrail regression near-veto; back-compat path unchanged). Merge unchanged: merge_attempt(winner) now targets task's own repo via resolveRepo/overlay.repos (from ①). Back-compat: no metric spec / no measurements ⇒ original test+rationale path. Daemon NOT restarted; no live graph/judge run.
